scope: Observation-only candidate for system-home boundary; no descriptor, device properties, report dispatch, gesture limits, entitlement or notification producer change.

registry_query.api: IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty on the actual matched IOHIDEventService descendant
registry_query.bounds: Exactly six keys; CF type checks; strings at most191 printable bytes; numbers converted as signed64; Boolean actualvalue; other types only typeID. No whole dictionary or data value dump.
registry_query.permission: Read-only original IOKit property API; existing two owned virtual-device/userclient permissions unchanged. Diagnostic symbols unavailable are reported without blocking existing backend initialization.

notification_watch.name: com.apple.purplebuddy.readytoexit
notification_watch.original_provenance: SpringBoard original GOT0x1d40d8568→global0x1d0fcb078→CFString0x1dac81708; original Setup posts using CFNotificationCenterGetDarwinNotifyCenter at0x100010d04 and CFNotificationCenterPostNotification0x100010d20.
notification_watch.api: notify_register_check, initial notify_check to clear initial registration signal, later notify_check, notify_cancel on exit.
notification_watch.permission: Public read-only notification subscription/check APIs; no added entitlement and all actual registration/check errors are logged.
notification_watch.placement: Start before virtual HID backend framework initialization; poll idle and before/after each explicit gesture.
notification_watch.limits: At most64 observation/error lines; unchanged7200-second helper lifetime. Changed flag means notification observed after registration, not current SpringBoard readiness or delivery proof.
